gap_local_none: (none - put an EVE installer ISO in the {folder})
prompt_disk_1: Kernel name of the target disk, without /dev/ (e.g. sda, nvme0n1, mmcblk0).
prompt_disk_2: Leave empty to let the installer choose.
prompt_persist_1: Disk(s) for /persist, comma separated (e.g. sdb or sdb,sdc).
prompt_persist_2: Several disks = ZFS. Empty = same disk as the installation.
prompt_server_1: Controller hostname, overrides the server in the ISO (e.g. zedcloud.local.zededa.net).
prompt_server_2: Empty = use what is in the ISO / config.img.
prompt_extra: Extra kernel parameters, appended at the end of the command line.
conf_k_warn: 'k' (kubevirt) variant: needs at least ~8 GB RAM and installs ZFS
conf_bb: Black box mode: information is collected, NOTHING is installed.
conf_wipe_warn: WARNING: the installer WIPES the target disk without further confirmation!
conf_nuke_warn: WARNING: eve_nuke_all_disks is ON - all disks will be wiped!
conf_press_i: Press [i] to start, any other key to go back...
boot_iso: Loading installer ISO (${eve_isomb} MB), this takes a while...
err_netboot_1: This ISO does not support the EVE netboot method (no 'isnetboot' in grub_include.cfg).
err_netboot_2: Use a newer EVE release or install from USB.
err_boot_1: Boot failed (${errno}). Check that ${eve_dir}/ is reachable
err_boot_2: and that the machine has enough RAM for the kernel plus the ${eve_isomb} MB ISO.
press_any: Press any key to go back...
shell_hint: Type 'exit' to return to the menu.
embed_fail: Could not load the EVE menu from
embed_prompt: Press [s] for the iPXE shell, otherwise booting from local disk...
